subtitle.en: A small open-source app written for one island, used every day since 2014.
subtitle.zh: 一个只为一座小岛写的开源小程序，2014 年起每天都有人在用。

story.en:
There is a small island where people take the ferry every morning to work and school. In 2014 Mira, a programmer who lived there, got tired of the paper timetable blowing away, and wrote this app. It is tiny: one timetable, one line that says how many minutes until the next boat, and a notice that turns on by itself when a storm stops the ferries.

For twelve years it has had no ads and no accounts, and the code has always been open. Three islanders now take turns looking after it.

*This exhibit and everyone in it are fictional. It shows what an exhibit can hold.*
story.zh:
海边有一座小岛，岛上的人每天早上坐渡轮去对岸上班上学。2014 年，住在岛上的程序员米拉嫌纸质时刻表总被风吹走，就写了这个小程序。它很小：一张时刻表、一行"下一班还有几分钟"、台风停航时自动亮起的通知。

十二年来它没有广告，没有账号，代码一直开源。现在由三位岛民轮流照看。

*这个展位和里面的人都是虚构的，用来展示一个展位能放些什么。*

greeting.en: Hello. This is the exhibit of the Island Ferry Timetable. Mira left a letter and some practical notes for whoever takes it over. Two questions, and they are yours.
greeting.zh: 你好，这里是小岛渡轮时刻表的展位。米拉给接手这个项目的人留了一封信和一些交代。回答两个问题，它们就交给你。

q.en: How many ferries run each day?

letter.en:
To whoever carries this on,

Thank you. Three things matter more than any feature: it must load in two seconds on an old phone, it must never show an ad, and the storm notice must be right. People decide whether to stand on a cold pier because of that one line.

Ideas I never got to: a Braille-friendly layout, and a small sound when the last ferry of the day is ten minutes away.

If one day nobody needs it any more, archive it and let it rest. That is fine too.

Mira, March 2026
letter.zh:
致接着照看它的人：

谢谢你。比任何新功能都重要的有三件事：在旧手机上两秒内打开；永远不放广告；台风停航的通知必须准。大家要不要站到冷风里的码头上，就看那一行字。

我一直没来得及做的：一个适合视障者的版式，以及末班船前十分钟的一声提示音。

如果有一天岛上不再需要它，就把它归档，让它歇着，这样也很好。

米拉，2026 年 3 月

pointer.en: Renewal dates for the domain and the server are in section 2 of the maintainers' handbook. For the domain, ask Old Chen at the island post office.
pointer.zh: 域名和服务器的续费日期写在维护者手册第 2 节。域名的事，找岛上邮局的老陈。
